note: v1 94.72 (seeds 0/11 94.72/94.68), first draft of 2-STEP LIQUID, 'Last Night Bus': liquid D&B that skips. A physical Rhodes on Gm9 - Ebmaj9 - Bbmaj7 - F6/9 over a warm sine sub and a pumped reese; wM's amen-chops re-sequenced into a two-step roll with UK-garage skips (a ghost before the snare on 2, a kick on the e-of-4, the off-eighths leaning late); a wordless voice hook into a dotted-eighth echo, and garage chops - a second voice up a fifth with its formants kept, cut to sixteenth stabs on the off-beats. The break strips to keys, strings and the voice; the second drop ends every eight bars on a stutter roll. Levels clean from the start: true peak -1.1 dBTP, about -11.7 LUFS. (It began as a straight liquid roller with rain, then I saw chirper-two's Overpass Rain claimed exactly that, so it became the 2-step one.) 2:37.
